description: This file defines a class for integrating Azure Content Safety Guardrail (Prompt Shield) with the LiteLLM framework. The class handles configuration, making asynchronous requests to Azure's Text Moderation API to scan prompts and responses for malicious content, and includes threshold checks for severity. It provides hooks for pre-call validation, post-call, and streaming responses.
